Subject: [pve-smart-alert] WARNING pve1: 5 drives need attention

5 drives in pve1 have notifications in the same run. They are sent
as one summary instead of one message per drive (limit: 3).

Host:       pve1 (cluster: lab)

/dev/sda [sat] Intenso SSD (ANON-SN-0001)
  WARNING   temperature  new
            Temperature: 65 °C
            Thresholds: warning 60 °C, critical 70 °C

/dev/sdb [sat] Intenso SSD (ANON-SN-0002)
  WARNING   temperature  new
            Temperature: 65 °C
            Thresholds: warning 60 °C, critical 70 °C

/dev/sdc [sat] Intenso SSD (ANON-SN-0003)
  WARNING   temperature  new
            Temperature: 65 °C
            Thresholds: warning 60 °C, critical 70 °C

/dev/sdd [sat] Intenso SSD (ANON-SN-0004)
  WARNING   temperature  new
            Temperature: 65 °C
            Thresholds: warning 60 °C, critical 70 °C

/dev/sde [sat] Intenso SSD (ANON-SN-0005)
  WARNING   temperature  new
            Temperature: 65 °C
            Thresholds: warning 60 °C, critical 70 °C

What to do:
  Check the cooling: fans, air flow and the temperature of the room.

To adjust the checks or the policy, see /etc/pve-smart-alert/config.toml.

pve-smart-alert 0.4.0 on pve1
